executive_summary.headline: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
executive_summary.body: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, which can return interactive interfaces rather than only static text, and announced a rollout to ChatGPT users.

executive_summary.headline: Google Playground lets people create and play custom games
executive_summary.body: Google's experimental Playground lets eligible U.S. adults create, play, and share custom games using text prompts.

executive_summary.headline: Borrowable ideas came from creators, indie builders, and scientific workflows.
executive_summary.body: The strongest signal this week is a set of visible demos and working tools that make new AI behaviors easier to try.

top_picks.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
top_picks.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, which can return interactive interfaces rather than only static text, and announced a rollout to ChatGPT users.
top_picks.author: OpenAI
top_picks.pricing: Available through ChatGPT plans; see OpenAI announcement.
top_picks.competitive_context: Moves the assistant from answer-only chat toward small interactive artifacts.
key_takeaways: Interactive interfaces are part of the answer surface.
The feature is rolling out to ChatGPT users.
Try it on a task that benefits from a small custom UI.

top_picks.title: Google Playground lets people create and play custom games
top_picks.summary: Google's experimental Playground lets eligible U.S. adults create, play, and share custom games using text prompts.
top_picks.author: Google
top_picks.pricing: Access tiers vary by Google AI subscription.
top_picks.competitive_context: Turns game generation into a consumer-facing create-play-share loop.
key_takeaways: Games can start from a plain-language prompt.
The experiment includes creation, play, and sharing.
A playful format can make model capability visible.

top_picks.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
top_picks.summary: Anthropic's Haiku 5.5 is positioned as its fastest small model for cost-sensitive and high-volume tasks.
top_picks.author: Anthropic / Product Hunt
top_picks.pricing: See the current Anthropic API pricing.
top_picks.competitive_context: A small fast model expands the range of tasks that can be delegated economically.
key_takeaways: Haiku 5.5 targets fast, high-volume work.
Product Hunt lists it as a current-week launch.
Compare it on one repeatable task against a larger model.

top_picks.title: Claude Dashboards and Motion
top_picks.summary: Claude Dashboards turns plain-language questions into live data-connected dashboards, while Motion creates editable animations and exports them as video.
top_picks.author: Anthropic / Product Hunt
top_picks.pricing: Beta; see product page for access.
top_picks.competitive_context: One assistant now produces two kinds of artifacts: analytical dashboards and editable motion graphics.
key_takeaways: Dashboards can connect to data.
Motion creates editable animations.
Both features turn ideas into artifacts.

top_picks.title: TikTok Shopping Assistant
top_picks.summary: TikTok announced a conversational shopping assistant that can answer product questions about details, shipping, sizing, and availability inside the app.
top_picks.author: TikTok Newsroom
top_picks.competitive_context: Brings product discovery and purchase questions into a conversational feed experience.
key_takeaways: The assistant can answer product questions in context.
Shopping guidance stays within TikTok touchpoints.
Conversation becomes a product-discovery surface.

top_picks.title: X Lift AI campaign builder for small businesses
top_picks.summary: X Lift can use a business website to draft ad copy, creative, and targeting, with a person reviewing the campaign before launch.
top_picks.author: Net Influencer
top_picks.pricing: See X Ads for current availability and pricing.
top_picks.competitive_context: Turns a small business's existing website into a starting brief for paid social.
key_takeaways: The website supplies campaign context.
The system drafts multiple campaign components.
A small business can move from site to campaign draft.

sections.title: Frontier Models and Interactive AI
sections.description: Model and interface releases that change what users can do.

sections.title: Consumer, Creator, and Small-Business Tools
sections.description: Products that make a new AI workflow available to individuals and smaller operators.

items.title: TikTok Agentic Leads
items.summary: TikTok announced Agentic Leads, an AI-guided lead-generation feature that helps advertisers capture and qualify prospects through conversations.
items.author: TikTok Newsroom
items.pricing: Advertiser product; details in TikTok announcement.
items.competitive_context: Treats qualification as a useful conversation rather than a static form.
key_takeaways: AI-guided conversations can qualify prospects.
The flow can reach DMs and advertiser sites.
A conversation can carry the next action.

items.title: TikTok for Business MCP connector
items.summary: TikTok announced an MCP connector for planning, launching, and managing advertising workflows through supported AI platforms.
items.author: TikTok Newsroom
items.pricing: Availability depends on the connected platform.
items.competitive_context: Connects a social advertising workflow to general-purpose agent interfaces.
key_takeaways: The connector exposes TikTok Ads workflows.
It supports planning and campaign management.
A social workflow can be invoked from an agent.

items.title: Smart+ Creative Selection
items.summary: TikTok's Smart+ Creative Selection brings advertiser assets, AI-generated creatives, and creator content into a single approval workflow.
items.author: TikTok Newsroom
items.pricing: Included in the Smart+ product suite; see TikTok announcement.
items.competitive_context: Puts human and AI creative options in one reviewable selection flow.
key_takeaways: Multiple sources of creative can be considered together.
The workflow includes creator content.
One surface can organize creative choice.

items.title: TikTok Ad Network
items.summary: TikTok announced an ad-network expansion that lets U.S. advertisers extend campaigns beyond TikTok across a network of apps.
items.author: TikTok Newsroom
items.pricing: Advertiser product; see TikTok for details.
items.competitive_context: Extends a creator-discovery platform's campaign reach beyond its own feed.
key_takeaways: Advertisers can reach audiences outside TikTok.
The product is managed through TikTok Ads.
The campaign surface expands across apps.

items.title: OpenScreen 2
items.summary: OpenScreen 2 records demos and lets an AI agent edit recordings, including planning zooms from clicks.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: See maker page for current plan.
items.competitive_context: Makes the editing pass part of the screen-recording workflow.
key_takeaways: A recording can be edited through an agent.
Zooms can be planned from clicks.
Demo production can start from one capture.

items.title: Ghost Core is an on-device personal AI computer
items.summary: Ghost Core is presented as a local AI computer that connects models to apps, files, and devices while maintaining continuous context.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.competitive_context: A dedicated local computer packages models, files, and context into a personal appliance.
key_takeaways: Models run on the device.
The product connects to apps, files, and devices.
Continuous context is the product premise.

items.title: ChickyTutor is an AI voice tutor for 70+ languages
items.summary: ChickyTutor offers spoken language practice with an AI tutor across more than 70 languages.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.competitive_context: Turns conversation practice into an always-available tutor.
key_takeaways: Voice is the main learning interface.
The product spans many languages.
Practice can be personalized to the learner.

items.title: Onepin makes voiceovers pronounce every name, price, and date correctly
items.summary: Onepin is a voiceover workflow that helps creators pronounce exact names, prices, and dates correctly in generated narration.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: See product page for current plan.
items.competitive_context: Targets the small factual details that often force a creator to re-record.
key_takeaways: Names and numbers are the focus.
Voiceover creation is built around revision.
The tool fits tutorial and product-video workflows.

items.title: OpenSwarm coordinates specialist agents for non-code work
items.summary: OpenSwarm is an open-source multi-agent CLI for producing non-code deliverables with specialist roles and orchestrated handoffs.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.competitive_context: Carries coding-agent orchestration patterns into documents and other deliverables.
key_takeaways: Specialist roles can work on non-code outputs.
Handoffs are explicit.
A local workspace can supply project context.

sections.title: Product Hunt and Indie Launches
sections.description: Current-week products with a maker-facing or consumer-facing workflow.

items.title: Busabase is a shared system of record for people and agents
items.summary: Busabase is an open-source workspace and database for managing records, documents, skills, and apps with AI agents.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: Cloud and desktop options; see product page.
items.competitive_context: Gives human and agent work a shared, structured home.
key_takeaways: Records and docs sit in one workspace.
Agents are intended users of the system.
The product includes both cloud and personal desktop modes.

items.title: FastRouter.ai routes requests across models
items.summary: FastRouter.ai offers a unified API that routes requests across many language models based on cost, latency, and quality.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: See product page for current pricing.
items.competitive_context: Makes model selection a tunable part of an application rather than a hard-coded choice.
key_takeaways: One API can reach multiple models.
Routing considers cost, latency, and quality.
A fallback path can be part of the design.

items.title: DailyHelm turns business analytics into a daily list of fixes
items.summary: DailyHelm watches business metrics and produces a prioritized list of suggested fixes ranked by likely revenue impact.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: See product page for current plan.
items.competitive_context: Turns a dashboard into a daily action queue for a small operator.
key_takeaways: The output is a prioritized to-do list.
The system connects analytics to suggested actions.
A small team can focus on the next useful fix.

items.title: Odyssey 3 generates interactive worlds from prompts
items.summary: Odyssey 3 is described as a real-time world model that creates interactive environments from prompts and predicts how they change.
items.author: Product Hunt
items.pricing: See maker page for current access.
items.competitive_context: Moves generative media from a clip toward an environment that responds to actions.
key_takeaways: The output is interactive.
The system models changes in real time.
World generation offers a new creative surface.

items.title: Google Cloud introduces a Gemini workplace agent
items.summary: Google Cloud describes a Gemini agent that can plan work, use skills, and connect to workplace systems across productivity and development tools.
items.author: Google Cloud
items.competitive_context: Shows a cloud platform framing an agent as a cross-tool work surface.
key_takeaways: The agent plans and uses skills.
It connects to workplace systems.
The integration is designed to return work in familiar tools.

sections.title: Enterprise AI
sections.description: Platform releases; kept to a small share of the week's mix.

items.title: YouTube announces new creator and AI features
items.summary: A current-week recap covers YouTube's announced creator features, including AI editing tools and new Shorts and live formats.
items.author: YouTube creator recap
items.competitive_context: Creator platforms increasingly combine generation with distribution and audience tools.
key_takeaways: The update spans creation and publishing.
AI editing is part of a broader creator feature set.
The platform connects work to distribution.
